title: The RPM Dividend: Virtualizing Primary Care in the Green Mountains
summary: How Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) is transforming the clinical workflow for chronic disease management in rural Vermont. Focus on hypertension and diabetes outcomes.

children.text: Clinical outcomes improve when the data flows continuously. By integrating RPM directly into the EMR, we reduce emergency department visits by 22% for high-risk diabetic populations. This is the clinical engine of 'Maximizing Health.'
